DIRECT GEOMETRY EDITING

A globe. Your geometry.

Circle
Choose Circle and click the globe to place its centre. Drag the centre to move it, or the edge handle to resize it. Radius is measured over the WGS 84 ellipsoid.
Polygon
Click to add vertices. Fill appears at three points. Double-click, press Enter, or choose Finish to close the polygon. Drag inside a selected polygon to move the entire shape around the globe. Drag its solid handles to edit; click hollow midpoint handles to insert a vertex. Click overlapping shapes to choose one from a popup menu.
Navigate & manage
Drag empty globe to orbit. Scroll or pinch to zoom. V selects, C draws a circle, P draws a polygon. Escape cancels drawing or deselects. Delete removes the selected shape. Drawings save on this browser.
Imagery: Natural Earth II (public domain). Globe: CesiumJS 1.121.0. Natural Earth is a low-resolution global basemap; zooming in does not add street-level detail.
